title: CommitPlanResponse
description: The plan committed and merged, and the slice requests of its first wave.

commit.description: The commit that holds the plan.

merged.description: The integration branch's commit once the plan is merged.

into.description: The integration branch: the setting into.

plan.description: The plan file committed, docs/plans/ and the next free number, then the job.

items.description: A request the workflow rounds takes as its trigger: planned, base, bugs and interface.

wave.description: For each slice of the first wave, the slice request the rounds take, with the plan's commit as base.

dropped.description: A branch of the same name an earlier run left, dropped before the cut, with its commit so its work can be found again; left out when there was none.

commit.description: The commit it pointed at, in full; git branch <name> <commit> brings it back until git collects it.

stayed.description: A branch forge asked to drop and worktrees kept, with the reason it gave; left out when every drop went through.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.
